## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and scope. Link a sanitized issue where applicable.

## Validation

List exact commands and actual results, including failures and missing prerequisites. Explain coverage. Include safe visual evidence for UI changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I have authority to contribute under Apache-2.0 and preserved third-party terms.
- [ ] No secrets, operational/private data or blind reference answers are included.
- [ ] Recorded evidence, human approvals and blinding/exposure records remain truthful.
- [ ] Dependencies, lockfiles, docs and tests are consistent; pinned gates remain intact.
- [ ] Limitations and pending owner decisions are explicit; no production safety claim is implied.
